bio: This restaurant is part of a delightful hotel situated some 6km from the medieval town of Sigüenza, where the owners have restored a 15C flour mill. Here, surrounded by stone, wood and myriad tasteful details, the brother and sister team of Samuel and Blanca Moreno create modern cuisine rooted in tradition which aims to highlight the splendid seasonal bounty of the mountains around Sigüenza, hence the focus on wild mushrooms, game and vegetables from the property’s own garden. In its attractive dining spaces, complemented by an enclosed glass-fronted terrace, guests can choose between several interesting tasting menus (Molienda, Clásicos and Esencia).
